footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to General Motors: includes $483M from preferred dividends; after $83.0M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 1.3% to $185.0B in 2025. Operating income fell 77.2% to $2.9B, a 1.6% margin.
Net income fell 55.8% to $3.2B, or $3.27 per share. Operating cash flow was $26.9B and free cash flow $17.6B, versus $9.3B; General Motors returned $6.7B through dividends and buybacks.
sources: General Motors Company Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
